title: Wangan Midnight
synopsis: When high school student Akio Asakura loses a high speed race to a Porsche 911 Turbo known as "Blackbird," he goes to a junkyard to find parts for his car - only to discover a blue first-generation Datsun Fairlady Z (S30), which he buys. Akio later discovers that not only is the Z tuned to 620 bhp, it's had a dark history of unfortunate accidents with its previous owners. Making matters more complicated is the fact that the last owner shared the same name with Akio. With the "Devil Z," Akio forms a new rivalry with the Blackbird and its driver Tatsuya Shima. (Source: Anime News Network)

synopsis: Mark Stuart had realized something terrifying: he had been reincarnated as the mid-boss in a game! In the original game, he was fated to be condemned by his daughter, Forsina, who was known as the “Ice Maiden.” Reflecting on his past coldness toward her, he resolves to change his fate by earning her affection. Through his thoughtfulness and his actions as a duke, his daughter begins to regain her love and trust in her father, but he ends up going too far, and her love becomes overwhelmingly heavy, putting him again in danger of getting condemned...!? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kanreki Hime
synopsis: Hiroya Oku’s first completely new series in four years! The protagonists are... six middle-aged men?! The story is set in a share house inhabited by six men approaching their 60s. titleNative: 放課後、僕らは宇宙に惑う
synonyms: After School, We Wander in Space.
synopsis: Kinoshima Rocketry Club casually uploaded a vlog of a test firing of their hybrid engine. The engine exploded — blowing away their dream of reaching space with it — but that wasn't the only thing that blew up in that video. Ayame Madoi, a girl who worked on the engine section who happened to appear in the vlog, also exploded in popularity when viewers from across the world found her cute. While she finds this attention bewildering, she actually already has someone she wishes would notice her that way… (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Mietemasu yo! Aizawa-san
titleNative: 見えてますよ! 愛沢さん
synopsis: Michi has always been troubled by the fact that she can see ghosts. She pretends not to see, trying not to get involved. However, a ghost has appeared that even she cannot ignore. It is Honami Aizawa, a former member of the popular idol group De:LPhinus. She was also a classmate of Michi, and she haunts the classroom out of unfulfilled longing. Michi is determined not to get involved with ghosts, but she finds herself following Honami's childish and outlandish behavior, unable to look away from her ardent fan-service(?)....... (Source: Comic Valkyrie, translated)

title: Mogura no Uta
synopsis: Tanibukuro city's Officer Kikukawa Reiji is the problem child of the police force. He doesn't always follow protocol and he enforces justice through his own personal morals. But it was that exact unwavering sense of righteousness that convinced the chief of police that Reiji was a perfect fit for a top secret undercover mission. He is given the task of infiltrating the Sukiya organization, the biggest and most dangerous mafia group of the Kanto region, and find solid evidence to arrest its leader Todoroki Shuho. But being accepted and trusted in the mafia means Reiji has to do unthinkable things and put himself in dangerous situations where one little slip and his life would be over. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Yane no Shita no Artemis
titleNative: 屋根の下のアルテミス
synopsis: A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!? When the poor university student Sanosuke Saraki started at a new part-time job at his old high school, he unexpectedly reunites with Koharu Kobachi, a classmate that he admired as a brilliant genius. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who must repeat her senior year for the second time…! Saraki's mission is to "help Koharu graduate by the end of the year." A coming-of-age story about starting over with a 20-year-old high school student!

title: Witch of Mine
synonyms: แม่มดของฉัน
synopsis: In these times, if you're too good or bad at something or simply too beautiful, you're called a witch. But there also exist magical beings called witches, who have the power to travel through both time and different dimensions, and sometimes do in the pursuit of love with human beings. Up against twists of fate and time, an outcast young boy and a mysterious witch, shunned because they're different from what's considered normal, one due to his imperfection and one due to her perfection, will need more than just magic spells and incantations...they'll need each other. (Source: ABLAZE) Note: The chapter count includes a prologue, seven side story chapters, and four special chapters.
